Serious consumer delinquencies remain historically elevated in the US:

Student loan serious delinquencies rose +0.3 percentage points in Q2 2026, to 10.6%, the highest since Q1 2020.

This marks the 3rd consecutive quarterly increase, totaling +1.2 percentage points.

items.headline:
JANE STREET TAKES $15 BILLION JULY HIT

Jane Street lost about $15 billion in July as the AI selloff hit its exposure to Situational Awareness and other technology positions, Reuters reports.

The firm has still generated more than $40 billion in trading revenue this year.
